events.label: egg_fall_fail

events.label: egg_fall_fail
events.what: The egg slides off the high platform and tumbles all the way down to a lower level.

events.label: egg_cracks_fall
events.what: The egg loses balance on the top edge and tumbles down the wooden slope.

events.label: egg_shatters_crack
events.what: The egg drops from a high ledge and shatters completely on the glass roof.

events.label: epic_shortcut_skip
events.what: The egg bounces off a moving mechanical lever, launching high into the air and skipping an entire section.

events.label: checkpoint_reached

events.label: egg_shatters_fall

events.label: fatal_fall_grass
events.what: The egg falls off the high structure, cracking open as it hits the ground in the tall grass.

events.label: disastrous_long_fall
events.what: The egg slips off the top rock, falling all the way down through the entire tower to the very bottom.
